## About
Vegas Valley Fleet & Auto is a family business. The Krshul brothers came together after years in the trade to offer what real people and companies need: quality service and friendly people. We were born and raised in the Las Vegas Valley, and we treat the folks who come through our door like family and neighbors.
We work on gas, diesel and hybrid vehicles, foreign and domestic, from a simple oil change to a major transmission repair. We also look after local business fleets so they can keep running without a full time repair team of their own.
We don't promise impossibly low prices. We promise quality maintenance and repair you can count on, done by ASE certified technicians who want to get it right the first time.

## Services
- Fleet services and repairs: Service and repairs for business fleets, so your vehicles stay on the road.
- Brake maintenance and repair: Brake maintenance and repair so your vehicle stops when you need it to.
- Diesel service and repair: Service and repair for diesel vehicles.
- Oil change and transmission repair: From a simple oil change to a major transmission repair.
- Tire replacement: We replace tires.
- Custom metal fabrication: Custom metal fabrication for your vehicle, your projects or your business.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do my factory warranty maintenance?
A: Yes. We perform warranty required maintenance while keeping your factory warranty requirements in place.

Q: Do you work on foreign and domestic vehicles?
A: Yes. Our technicians handle major and minor auto repair on foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. The shop is open weekdays and closed Saturday and Sunday.
